Oneliner

Educational mission to measure the health and attitude of the satellite.
Description

Simple testbed that want to measure the vital and attitude parameters of a satellite. Project is mainly oriented for educational purposes. Different sensors, LED beacon visible from ground.

Launch booked on Unisat-7.
